summary: Precision-mode safeguard and transient-load unwind playbook for tenant
description: Issue summary: Customer Brightpost Health reported a surge of 95th/99th percentile latency spikes and an uptick in 5xx errors after enabling a combined optimization package (dynamic batching aggressive thresholds + KV prefetch + 4-bit quant profile) across a set of high-concurrency routes. Impact: Customer-facing API latency spikes caused degraded user experience and some automated retry loops increasing downstream load. Request: Customer requested an orchestrated, low-risk unwind (per-tenant) that preserves warmed KV state where safe, avoids immediate accuracy regressions, and returns traffic to stable latency SLOs without a full service restart. Additional context: the tenant is on Dedicated capacity with pinned model versions and uses long-session chat workflows (median seq len ~820). The optimization change was rolled at 02:15 UTC on 2026-03-10 via the console experimentation flow.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In prod us-east, apply optimizer profile: {dynamic_batch_threshold: aggressive, kv_prefetch: enabled, quant_profile: 4bit-fast} to routes /v1/chat/brightpost/*
2) Send mixed session traffic with median seq length ~800 and a 20% long-tail of >1500 tokens
3) Observe P95/P99 token latency and sporadic 5xx errors within 5-10 minutes; monitor GPU utilization, queue depth, and KV cache hit ratio
4) Reproduce by toggling quant_profile back to bfloat16 to validate latency regressions reduce
logs: 2026-03-10T02:24:05Z telemetry NOTICE kvcache.cpp: eviction_rate increased from 2% to 28% after prefetchenable
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: sequence-length shift interacting with aggressive dynamic batching caused oversized batches and GPU stragglers, amplifying latency. Long sessions with large KV contexts triggered eviction churn in KV cache when prefetching attempted to load many prefixes.

Quantization observation: the 4-bit 'fast' profile reduced model memory but increased decode retries for longer contexts; we observed more token-level retry loops from the tokenizer layer, increasing CPU work and request tail latency.

Confirmed correlation: enabling the profile in a staging replay with matched traffic reproduced elevated P99s and elevated queue depths; reverting quant_profile to bfloat16 reduced tail latency by ~35% in that test.
No code regressions found in serving runtime around the deployment window; change originated from optimizer policy update via Console feature flags (flag id: optpkg-2026-0301).

Risk: immediate full rollback will drop cache locality and could increase cold-start token cost; need an approach that preserves KV warm state where safe and prevents repeated OOMs while restoring latency SLOs.
comments: 2026-03-10 03:02 - Support (Ava): Acknowledged. Opening per-tenant rollback plan and tagging SRE for live mitigation. First response ETA 30m.

2026-03-10 03:18 - SRE (Liam): Observed GPU queue backlog on gpool-us-east-3; recommending immediate circuit-breaker on dynamic_batch_size > 32 for this tenant and temporary throttle to 70% of previous concurrency.
2026-03-10 03:25 - Customer (Brightpost): Confirmed impact on interactive clinical note generation flows. Requesting minimal functional impact and prefers not to re-run long session histories.

2026-03-11 09:12 - Support (Ava): Drafting a staged unwind playbook: (A) pin quant_profile to bfloat16 for high-session routes, (B) reduce batch threshold to conservative, (C) enable small canary (5%) to validate latency, (D) rehydrate KV from snapshot for routes that accept rehydrate, else allow graceful eviction.

2026-03-12 14:40 - Eng on-call (Priya): Prepared a small hotpatch to circuit-break dynamic_batching via flag optpkg-2026-0301-holdpoint and added telemetry guard to alert if eviction_rate > 15% post-change.
2026-03-12 15:03 - Customer (Brightpost): Approved staged unwind and requested run during their low-traffic window (03:00–06:00 local).
resolution: 1) Add holdpoint flag optpkg-2026-0301-holdpoint to freeze the aggressive optimizer profile for Brightpost tenant routes (no immediate revert).
2) Apply conservative per-route overrides: set quant_profile=bfloat16 for /v1/chat/brightpost/high-session and dynamic_batch_threshold=conservative; limit max_batch_size=32.
3) Throttle concurrency to 70% of current for the tenant using scheduler rate-limit for 01:00-05:00 UTC low-traffic window.

4) Rehydrate KV: restore latest tenant snapshot (snapshot id: bp-2026-03-09-2310) into warm-cache for routes that support snapshot restore; for other routes allow controlled eviction with eviction_limit=10% per minute.
5) Canary ramp: route 5% traffic for 30 minutes, verify P95 < 800ms and 5xx rate < 0.1%. If stable, step to 25% for 60 minutes then full traffic.
6) Post-change telemetry: enable temporary alerting on kv_eviction_rate, batch_queue_depth, and decode_retry_rate with 5-minute aggregation windows.

7) Follow-up: run an accuracy regression job against static prompt set for long-session chats to check token-level divergence. If accuracy drop detected, coordinate with Applied ML for targeted quant profile adjustments.

Rollback plan: If canary fails, immediately flip optpkg-2026-0301-holdpoint off (revert to prior snapshot) and route customer to warm-standby or increase Dedicated capacity for short-term stabilization.
Owner: SRE (Liam) / Support (Ava) with Eng-On-Call (Priya) as escalation. Expected completion: 2026-03-13 07:00 UTC.
